steps.content: Ring, ring, ring...
In a daze, you hear the phone ringing. A speck of white light is trembling, and from it comes a familiar timid voice...
...Hello, is this the radio program at 3 a.m.?
Oh wow, sorry, I didn't expect someone would actually answer. I, I need a second.
My name is Eleven. I'm about to graduate, and I'm a bit lost about work, the future, and myself...

steps.speaker: Eleven
steps.content: Everyone says you're the kindest host. I also... would love to hear your opinion. Can I?
That white dot flits about, timidly waiting for an answer. The answer is vague and you can't make out what's being said. You see a blurry figure next to you.
After a while, the figure gradually becomes solid. You recognize her, it's Eleven. She looks gloomy at the moment.

steps.speaker: Eleven
steps.content: ...I don't remember.

steps.speaker: Eleven
steps.content: All I can recall is her being understanding and making me feel that the future wasn't so scary, and that there were things to look forward to. For the first time, I had aspirations.

steps.speaker: Eleven
steps.content: I wanted to join the radio like her. I wanted to help everyone solve their problems and listen to people share happy things and beautiful moods. I aspired to listen to warm and wonderful voices and pass them on.

steps.speaker: Eleven
steps.content: But as soon as I entered her radio station, I realized things were not as they seemed. Behind the glitz, the voices I heard were chaos...

steps.speaker: Listener A
steps.content: Once you pick up my call, you're as good as dead! You'll never have a good time, not even in your next life! Hahaha, scared you, didn't I? Serves you right!

steps.speaker: Listener B
steps.content: Hey, why don't you pose as that calls from 3 a.m. thing? You might get even more popular than you are now!

steps.speaker: Eleven
steps.content: Ah... I realized that a voice was not only used for conveying affection and messages. It can become a knife that stabs into the hearts of strangers.

steps.speaker: Eleven
steps.content: So, words are not used to express oneself. No one cares what you think. They're just waiting for you to say what they want to hear.

steps.speaker: Eleven
steps.content: The world is so big... I'm just a voice behind the screen. I am a radio station, an emotional trash can at everyone's disposal, a jukebox that should never make mistakes.

steps.speaker: Eleven
steps.content: It cuts way deeper than feeling lost when I knew nothing. Is this what I wanted? Should I keep going? What was that initial dream I had?

steps.speaker: Eleven
steps.content: If possible, I want to find that radio host. I want her to clear my confusion again. I want to hear what she said to me once more. I need her to give me strength.

steps.speaker: Eleven
steps.content: But my memory is fading. I'm a radio station always on air, and I've long been overwhelmed by malice. I've completely forgotten what a beautiful voice should sound like.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Let's not talk about work now. Take your time to search, I'll wait for you.
The glow of the shackles reemerges, like the first light of dawn in this world.
Ring, ring, ring...
...Hello, is this the radio program at 3 a.m.?
Oh wow, sorry, I didn't expect someone would actually answer. I, I need a second.
My name is Eleven. I'm about to graduate, and I'm a bit lost about work, the future, and myself...

steps.speaker: Eleven
steps.content: Everyone says you're the kindest host. I also... would love to hear your opinion. Can I?

You've lost count of how many times it's been replayed, but you still can't make out the host's answer. The memories you've painstakingly recollected are only of Eleven's own voice in her student days.

steps.speaker: Eleven
steps.content: My parents keep pushing me. They don't believe in me and want me to follow their plan. Become a clerk and work a 9 to 5 job.

steps.speaker: Eleven
steps.content: My teachers advised that I continue my studies, or find a career in a big company. They told me to stay on the right path and never stray...

steps.speaker: Eleven
steps.content: A-and my friends said I should become an influencer, and that I hit all the criteria...

steps.speaker: Eleven
steps.content: Even the owner at my part-time job at the record store grew worried about my indecision.

steps.speaker: Eleven
steps.content: But I'm really not sure. I don't know what's right and what I can and want to do. There are so many voices around me. I don't know which one to follow. I know everyone means well, but I still feel irritated and want to escape...

steps.speaker: Eleven
steps.content: Um... Can you help me? Tell me whose advice I should follow, and what I should do?
The response becomes even more distant and almost inaudible. Silence ensues.

steps.speaker: Eleven
steps.content: ...Even you're not talking to me anymore. Have I been complaining too much? Have I bored you?

steps.speaker: Eleven
steps.content: ...I'm sorry, I can't think of a solution, and I'm not a good talker. I don't dare to talk about these things with others. I only dare... to tell you.

steps.speaker: Eleven
steps.content: I've been your listener for a long time. You always listen to everyone's troubles and your voice is ever so encouraging, so I...
The faint voice on the phone isn't heard again, as if its identity is insignificant, yet it seems ever present, in this place where every radio host lingers.
Meanwhile, after revealing her true feelings, the girl's anxiety is increasingly palpable. Even the sounds of her nervous breathing and her fumbling with her clothes are clearly audible.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Believe in yourself, just like how you've followed your inner voice. We will definitely restore everything to normal and find your lost voice.
Suddenly, you realize something and look at Eleven, whom you've asked to stay. The anxiety on her face is long gone, replaced by a quiet gaze at the faint white dot.

options: Should you say something to her?

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: You're also the host of Call at 3 AM, and she's your listener too.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Do you detest her emotions and expectations of you?
Eleven doesn't answer you or turn around, but simply stares blankly ahead. She begins with that perfect voice of the Call at 3 AM host.

steps.speaker: Eleven
steps.content: I'm sorry, I'm not that amazing. In the radio station, I'm nothing more than a jaded employee beneath the mask of a famous host. Work is exhausting and complicated. Adulting is hard, and the future... isn't that bright either.

steps.speaker: Eleven
steps.content: I understand your troubles, and maybe I can offer you some advice, but I don't have the answers to all your problems. I'm just a useless adult.

steps.speaker: Eleven
steps.content: But I'm glad you're willing to talk to me about these things. Your words might not be pleasant, perhaps a bit negative even, but they're your precious, honest thoughts, a true reflection of your struggles in life.

steps.speaker: Eleven
steps.content: Thank you for listening to my radio station, for choosing to confide in me, and for sharing your life with me. I really appreciate it.

steps.speaker: Eleven
steps.content: This is the voice I've been looking for and the reason why this radio station exists.
She begins sobbing silently. The white dot seems a little stunned, hovering around Eleven helplessly.

steps.speaker: Eleven
steps.content: Although I don't understand everything... you seem to really love this job and these voices. I also like it when people share their true feelings.

steps.speaker: Eleven
steps.content: I may be overreaching, but...

steps.speaker: Eleven
steps.content: I think I want to become a radio host like you. Do you think I can do it...?
You hear a faint voice buzzing in your ears like before, but this time it no longer makes you anxious, painful, or aggrieved.

steps.speaker: Female Voice
steps.content: Hello, Eleven. I hope my message didn't disturb your rest.

steps.speaker: Female Voice
steps.content: I just want to say that every night I spend staying up working, your voice cheers me up so much.

steps.speaker: Female Voice
steps.content: You're definitely not some ghost. You're my favorite record that gets me through the longest night.

steps.speaker: Male Voice
steps.content: Hi, this is my first time leaving a voicemail, I'm a bit unsure of what to say, haha...

steps.speaker: Male Voice
steps.content: The other day I was in the shop, I was quite surprised when I heard customers talking about Ghost Calls.

steps.speaker: Male Voice
steps.content: Because this is the program I listen to every night. If those are Ghost Calls, how am I still here?

steps.speaker: Male Voice
steps.content: Your voice is a rare prize, and you're putting it to good use. I believe in you and I'll keep supporting you.

steps.speaker: Female Voice
steps.content: I adore your voice, but the content of the program is a bit dry. Can't you talk about something exciting?

steps.speaker: Female Voice
steps.content: Oh, I don't mean to insinuate anything about those Ghost Calls. What a childish story. You don't think I'll fall for that, do you?

steps.speaker: Female Voice
steps.content: But to be frank, your program's content and sound effects lack surprises. That being said, I'll definitely continue to support you.
Amid the voices, beside Eleven, another voice quickly solidifies and transforms into another Eleven.

steps.speaker: Eleven
steps.content: ...Of course.
She replies, cradling the tiny speck of light and her trembling self in her arms.

steps.speaker: Eleven
steps.content: Oh, the timid Eleven, who's always struggling, and easily overwhelmed by malice...

steps.speaker: Eleven
steps.content: You still have to go on in this world.

steps.speaker: Eleven
steps.content: But... the good news is, I've found my initial strength, and I will never lose you again.

steps.speaker: Eleven
steps.content: Listen to different voices and pick out the sincere ones. Bring them to those in need and soften their hardened souls.

steps.speaker: Eleven
steps.content: You've got a nice voice too, one that makes your listeners happy.

steps.speaker: Eleven
steps.content: If you want, you can do it too.
Tears streaming down her face, Eleven glances at you and shows you a relieved, sincere smile.

steps.speaker: Eleven
steps.content: I guess you're done with your shift now. Thanks for your help.
Ding-a-ling...
The phone rings again, but this time it doesn't seem to wake anyone up.
You rub your eyes and pick up the phone. It's your device that was completely out of power earlier.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Huh? Wasn't it out of battery?
The screen displays an unknown number. For some reason, you seem to know who's calling because you're not at all surprised to receive this call.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Hello.

steps.speaker: Eleven
steps.content: Hello... ${PlayerName}.
The white void fades away as the noise grows louder in your ears. Slowly, you open your eyes widely.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Am... I back?
This is the center of Fifth Avenue in Eastside, where three streets intersect.
And you're standing in the middle of the street, watching the passersby. It's almost dawn.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: I'm back, Eleven.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: You should be back too, right?

steps.speaker: Eleven
steps.content: Yes, right now, I'm basking under the same sunlight as you.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: That's great.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: By the way, I forgot to tell you.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: I work as the Chief of the Minos Bureau of Crisis Control, specifically in charge of detaining Sinners...

steps.speaker: Eleven
steps.content: Hehe...

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: ...Why do you laugh?

steps.speaker: Eleven
steps.content: Thank you.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: ...I will find you.

steps.speaker: Eleven
steps.content: This will be the last Call at 3 AM.

steps.speaker: Eleven
steps.content: If you miss me, please just say...

steps.speaker: Eleven
steps.content: Goodbye.
